text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Whoa! So... many... people! And they<n>all have a
twinkle in their eye.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Today, Rice Shower and I are<n>watching the spring
Tenno Sho.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: One week ago, during training...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Huff... puff...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Wheeze... wheeze... Rice... wait up...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Huh? Wh-wh-what is it?

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
(This is Sakura Bakushin O. She's in<n>Rice Shower's
year, and she excels<n>in sprints.)

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
To tell you the truth, I have some<n>class
representative responsibilities I<n>was supposed to
take care of, but I<n>decided to run with you instead.
choice_data_list: (I don't remember her asking for a partner run...)
(I don't remember her asking for a partner run...)

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Your stamina is off the charts! So I'm<n>going to
make a suggestion!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
As a fellow long-distance runner, I<n>want you to
come watch the spring<n>Tenno Sho with me!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: You want to watch the Tenno Sho...<n>together?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Yep, together! Working with my fellow<n>classmates
to help them discover<n>their hidden talents is one of
my<n>duties as class representative, after<n>all!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
While I wouldn't call it a "hidden"<n>talent, Sakura
Bakushin O is correct.<n>Rice Shower has what it
takes to be a<n>long-distance stayer.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
And the spring Tenno Sho may<n>someday be a goal
of hers.
choice_data_list: Guess we're going to Kyoto then.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: A-are you sure?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Yay! I would have been so lonely<n>going on my own!
Also, we have a<n>snack budget of 300 yen!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Actually... it kind of feels like we're<n>going on a field
trip. Hehe, I'm getting<n>excited!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
Rounding the fourth corner with 600<n>meters left to
the finish line, the leader<n>is... Mejiro McQueen!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: Gooo, McQueen! Make them eat your<n>dust!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Whoa! This is a close one! I'm gonna<n>go get a
better view.

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro McQueen is widening her<n>lead! No matter
how hard the racers<n>behind her run...

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
They can't reach her! No one can<n>come close to
her!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
In a display of incredible speed,<n>Mejiro McQueen
crosses the finish<n>line in first! What a sight!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: Congrats! Good job, McQueen!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Thank you, everyone! It's thanks to<n>your support
that I managed to seize<n>victory!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
choice_data_list: You were on the edge of your seat, weren't you?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Yeah... She was incredible. So skilled...<n>and so
radiant!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
The farther McQueen ran, the more<n>everyone
smiled...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: She's just like the blue rose from the<n>picture book!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, the blue rose that brings<n>happiness to
everyone!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: Rice Shower excitedly retells the storyof The Blue Rose of Good Fortune.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
In a garden full of roses, a single blue<n>rose bud
suddenly bloomed.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
There had never been a blue rose<n>before, and the
people feared it. They<n>called it the "flower of
misfortune"<n>and kept their distance.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
But one day, someone bought the<n>rose. "Why, this
blue rose is simply<n>magnificent!" they exclaimed.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Then they—Big Brother—placed the<n>blue rose on his
windowsill, and it<n>bloomed so beautifully...

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Then they—Big Sister—placed the blue<n>rose on her
windowsill, and it<n>bloomed so beautifully...

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
That the people walking by would<n>smile from the
bottom of their hearts<n>when they saw it.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Well, McQueen has always been<n>well-liked, so it's
not exactly the<n>same.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
But... I want to be like that. I want to<n>be someone
who brings happiness<n>instead of misfortune.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: ...Hehe. You don't have to try and<n>cheer me up.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: But, if it's possible... I would like tobe.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
We watch Mejiro McQueen for a<n>while longer and
then head home.
